programs.name: Computer Science BSc
programs.a_level_offer: A*A*A, with grade A in Mathematics or Further Mathematics
programs.ib_offer: 39 points overall (includes TOK/EE) or an aggregate of 20 from three Higher Levels; must include grade 6 in HL Mathematics: Analysis & Approaches
programs.ap_offer: A*A*A equivalent: three APs at 5,5,5 plus ACT 30 or SAT 1410 (minimum 620 Maths and 650 Reading & Writing); or Route 2, five APs at 5,5,5,5,5. The A-level A in Mathematics requirement means a 5 in AP Calculus BC (AP Calculus AB does not meet a Mathematics subject requirement). Honors/Dual Enrolment classes count only for US-domiciled applicants whose school offers no APs; AP Research and AP Seminar are not accepted.
programs.required_subjects: A-level (or equivalent) grade A in Mathematics or Further Mathematics; Computing or Computer Science preferred, not required
programs.toefl_note: English language band D. TOEFL iBT taken before 21 Jan 2026 (old 0-120 scale): 92 overall with at least 23 in writing and 20 in each other skill. Taken from 21 Jan 2026 (new 1-6 scale): 4.5 overall with at least 4 in each skill.
programs.english_note: King's English language band D (Faculty of Natural, Mathematical & Engineering Sciences): IELTS Academic 6.5 overall and 6.0 in each skill; PTE Academic 62 with 59 in each skill. Tests must be dated within two years of 1 September 2027. Duolingo is not on the list and King's says tests not listed cannot be accepted.
programs.notes: Contextual offer: A-level AAA, IB 36 points (or 18 from three HL), both with the same Mathematics condition. Start date September 2027 (2027 entry page). No admissions test is listed on the course page. Fee: 2027-28 international fee shown on the course Fees tab (https://www.kcl.ac.uk/study/undergraduate/courses/computer-science-bsc/fees); subject to annual increases in later years of study. AP route (King's AP/SAT/ACT table, https://www.kcl.ac.uk/study/undergraduate/how-to-apply/entry-requirements): the 'Advanced Placement, ACT and SATs' section; King's US overview https://www.kcl.ac.uk/study/international/region/usa. English: https://www.kcl.ac.uk/study/undergraduate/how-to-apply/english-language-requirements.

programs.name: Economics BSc
programs.a_level_offer: A*AA, including grade A in Mathematics
programs.ib_offer: 38 points overall (includes TOK/EE) or an aggregate of 19 from three Higher Levels; must include grade 6 in HL Mathematics (Analysis & Approaches or Applications & Interpretation)
programs.ap_offer: A*AA equivalent: three APs at 5,5,5 plus ACT 29 or SAT 1380 (minimum 620 Maths and 650 Reading & Writing); or Route 2, five APs at 5,5,5,5,4. The A-level A in Mathematics requirement means a 5 in AP Calculus BC (AP Calculus AB does not meet a Mathematics subject requirement). AP Microeconomics and AP Macroeconomics can count as individual APs. Honors/Dual Enrolment classes count only for US-domiciled applicants whose school offers no APs.
programs.required_subjects: A-level (or equivalent) grade A in Mathematics
programs.toefl_note: English language band B. TOEFL iBT taken before 21 Jan 2026 (old 0-120 scale): 100 overall with at least 25 in writing and 23 in each other skill. Taken from 21 Jan 2026 (new 1-6 scale): 5 overall with at least 4.5 in each skill.
programs.english_note: King's English language band B: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall and 6.5 in each skill; PTE Academic 69 with 62 in each skill. Tests must be dated within two years of 1 September 2027. Duolingo is not on the list and King's says tests not listed cannot be accepted.
programs.notes: Contextual offer: A-level AAB, IB 35 points (or 17 from three HL), both with the same Mathematics condition. Start date September 2027. Fee: 2027-28 international fee shown on the course Fees tab (https://www.kcl.ac.uk/study/undergraduate/courses/economics-bsc/fees); subject to annual increases in later years of study. AP route (King's AP/SAT/ACT table, https://www.kcl.ac.uk/study/undergraduate/how-to-apply/entry-requirements): the 'Advanced Placement, ACT and SATs' section; King's US overview https://www.kcl.ac.uk/study/international/region/usa. English: https://www.kcl.ac.uk/study/undergraduate/how-to-apply/english-language-requirements.
